tool.name: run_script
tool.description: Run a JavaScript snippet against this tenant's Corsair. The snippet is an async function BODY: `return` your result. The only thing in scope is the global `corsair` — call operations as `await corsair.<plugin>.api.<op>(args)` (e.g. `await corsair.slack.api.channels.list({})`) and use ordinary JS (filter/map/loops) to combine them. Use list_operations / get_schema to discover paths and arguments. No network, filesystem, process, require, or imports are available — only corsair operations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Corsair Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Corsair Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.corsair.cloud/projsvjx3pghd5e/mcpg_bmdR0PIuYr8-THSiSEMil306iGG2tWAs/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Corsair Cloud MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Corsair Cloud scores 82/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Corsair Cloud's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Corsair Cloud scores 32/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 5 of 5 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Corsair Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Corsair Cloud in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
